scope: Full current service-area article and the Leon, Broward and Calhoun complete location records
finding: The guide adds Georgia to its studio coverage list. Its distinctions between business premises, service reach, address-level review and unconfirmed availability remain directly relevant to all three linked briefs.

before.label: Describe locations and service coverage accurately
before.reason: Leon explains the Midway workshop's location-specific repair limits and intermittent specialist availability before the customer transports a trailer. The guide asks which services are available at a genuine business location, rejects converting service reach into an office claim, and assigns maintenance of changing coverage and booking conditions. It therefore supports the current label and the record's explicit Midway/Gadsden versus Tallahassee/Leon distinction.
